approve.sentence: A second person approves only what they are shown in full, and this restore names 1025 topics, more than the 1024 a request shows. Split it into restores of at most 1024 topics each, requested and approved one by one, or approve it under a strict (personal-key) policy. It cannot be approved in the console.
